events.title: US BOND CRISIS: Bessent Intervenes to Cap Yields, National Debt Crosses $40 Trillion
events.summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced intention to artificially cap runaway Treasury yields, doubling government buybacks. 30-year yields hit 5.34% (highest since 2007). US national debt crossed $40T. Interest costs overtook Medicare as 2nd-largest budget item. Bond market meltdown driving fiscal crisis narrative.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis: Oil Spill Reaches Iranian Coast, Trump Threatens Economic Warfare
events.summary: US-Iran war continues. Oil spill from projectile hitting cargo vessel reached Irans Qeshm Island mangrove ecosystems. Trump threatened economic warfare against Iran, imposed new sanctions on Hezbollah. Oil prices rose 2%+. Iran lost significant control of Hormuz but US does not fully control it either. EIA forecasts oil prices remain elevated until flows normalize.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic: 5,290 Cases, 2,516 Deaths, WHO Says Spreading Faster Than Ability to Contain
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC now 5,290 confirmed cases, 2,516 deaths (up from 4,945/2,325 last scan). 837 hospitalized. Spread to Uganda. Aug 23 marks 100 days since outbreak declared. WHO says outbreak spreading faster than ability to contain. MSF says communities not receiving adequate support. Diagnostic delays because tests designed for Zaire, not Bundibugyo species.

events.title: Yen Intervention Failing: Yen Settled Near 159, Carry Trade Back On
events.summary: Joint US-Japan currency intervention has failed to sustain gains. By Aug 23, yen settled near 159. BOJ left rates unchanged (8-1 vote, Takata dissented calling for 1.25%). CNBC reports intervention gave investors better opportunity to put carry trade back on. Morgan Stanley notes intervention provided limited support. BOJ rate at just 1%.

events.title: 5th US Bank Failure of 2026: Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank Collapses
events.summary: Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank (Philadelphia, $68M assets) became 5th US bank failure of 2026 (up from 2 in all of 2025). Drip of small-bank closures continues. GOP banking deregulation in 2026 dismantling post-1929/2008 safeguards. Substack analysis warns of widening fault line could create bank crash worse than 1929.

events.title: Global Bond Sell-Off: Yields Highest Since Financial Crisis, Showing Signs of Easing
events.summary: Synchronized global bond sell-off intensified during week of Aug 18, showing signs of easing by Aug 21 but concerns remain. German 10Y Bund at 3.21% (highest since 2011). French 30Y at 4.86% (highest since 2008). UK 10Y at 5.06%. US 30Y at 5.34% (highest since 2007). Reuters: selling grips bond markets across US, Japan on inflation/fiscal worries.

events.title: Gold Above $4,500: Third Consecutive Weekly Gain on Safe Haven Demand
events.summary: Gold traded above $4,500/oz on Aug 21, on course for 3rd consecutive weekly gain. Investors turning to safe-haven metals amid currency/bond volatility. Rising oil prices underscore inflationary risks. Brent crude rose 6% last week with Hormuz tanker movements limited. US crude near $84.50/bbl.

events.title: China Property Crisis: Five-Year Downward Spiral, Bank Loans Contracting
events.summary: Bloomberg reports Chinas property market in downward spiral for 5 years. Values continue to plummet, households forced to sell. PBOC leaves loan rates steady for 15th consecutive month. July bank loans contracted (2nd time on record). Deflation fight faltering.

events.title: Nigeria Evacuates 83 More Citizens from South Africa Amid Afrophobic Attacks
events.summary: Nigeria evacuating another 83 citizens from South Africa on Aug 19, after nearly 1,490 already repatriated. Growing afrophobic attacks and anti-foreigner sentiments. JNIM-Islamic State conflict expanding regionally into Niger and Nigeria for first time in 2026.
